Hi recently bought 2x magic miner t40 and 2x  power kits, turns out i need
to cancel 1 set,
so 1 magic miner 40 and 1x power kit

I paid via paypal  ···· the billing address.

Sincerely

Hi Marvin,

Thanks for writing, and I'm glad you reached out before the units go out.

Here's where the order stands: Shop···· is paid, nothing has shipped yet, and the two Magic Miner 40T units ship November 21, 2026. Both of your units are already allocated to that production run, so what you paid has gone into the specific units being built for you. You can follow that shipment on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Cancelling half the order isn't something we do as a matter of course, so before anything else, let me give you two ways that keep the full value with you. First, I can hold the value of that second set, $868.99 for the miner and the Power Kit, as store credit on your account, which you can spend on anything we have in stock now, no waiting for November. Second, if the wait is the issue rather than the second unit, I can swap that set to something we hold on the shelf for Germany and get it out to you in days instead, and I'll tell you the exact price difference before anything changes.

If neither of those works for you and you'd still like the second set cancelled, tell me and I'll put the request in front of a supervisor to review, and they'll come back to you on it.

Just reply here and let me know which way you want to go.

Sincerely,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
